intro: Eyes of the Sentinels is a Darnassus quest where players assist Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in stationing magical scout owls at critical posts throughout the night elven capital. Facing growing unease across Teldrassil, this aerial surveillance bolsters the city's defenses while allowing the Sentinels time for prayer to Elune.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.
Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
